job_title: SAP Fioneer FPSL Banking Functional Consultant
key_responsibilities: FPSL Functional Configuration (Banking)
Configure FPSL objects for banking products including: Loans and advances, Deposits, Money market instruments, Securities bonds (if in scope)
Implement FPSL components: Contract types and contract attributes, Event types and event processing, Posting schemas and accounting determinations
Support setup of: Valuation areas, Subledger accounting layers, Accounting principles ledgers
Accounting IFRS 9 Support
Implement FPSL accounting logic aligned to: IFRS 9 classification (AC, FVOCI, FVTPL), Effective Interest Rate (EIR) based accruals, Fee and charge handling
Support postings related to: Initial recognition, Accruals and amortization, Derecognition events
Assist Finance Lead/Architect in validating: Accounting outcomes, Posting results at contract and GL level
Integration Support (Source Systems S/4HANA)
Support inbound integration from: Core banking systems, Treasury trading platforms
Assist with: Event payload validation, Attribute mappings and enrichments
Support outbound integration to: SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal
Validate: Document splitting, GL account derivation, Posting completeness and consistency
Testing, Reconciliation & Defect Resolution
Execute and support: Unit Testing (UT), System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
Perform and support reconciliations: Source system vs FPSL, FPSL subledger vs SAP GL
Analyze and resolve: Posting errors, Accounting mismatches, Integration defects
Support parallel run activities with legacy subledgers.
Documentation & Knowledge Transfer
Prepare functional deliverables including: Configuration documents, Test scripts and test evidence, Mapping and reconciliation documents
Support: Knowledge transfer to client teams, Go-live readiness, Hypercare activities
